notes.title: Muspell Alpha 13
notes.content:
Hey this is time for a long awaited Muspell update, with major improvements to the changelog!

Side note, I’m leaning towards making this game a programmable sandbox where players could design and share their own worlds and mods. That’s why I added Python scripting some releases ago and would like to work on a level editor at some point in the near future. Any ideas or feedback are welcome.

Here’s the changelog :

[list]
[*] Major change: Score and tiers
[*] Major change: New monster and character design
[*] Many UX fixes for gamepad and split screen
[*] New: Items are dropped on the ground
[*] New: Press X to remove a prop
[*] New Item: Compass show the direction of spawn point
[*] Minor UI improvements for monster health bar
[*] Gameplay: hold down action button to mine
[*] Gameplay: higher level pickaxe needed to mine rare ore
[*] Gameplay: You can’t sleep during the day
[*] Scripting: New commands gold, xp, create_item
[/list]

notes.title: Muspell Alpha 11
notes.content:
Hey, it’s time for a new Muspell update, and as it contains lots of fixes and potential breaking changes, feedback is more than welcome for this one!

Lots of things have been rewritten and the focus was made on getting the game enjoyable, stable and more fun. There are no new items or monsters for this release, even if we have a running prototype for projectiles!

Warning, the old worlds won’t load properly or not at all with this new release. Creative mode was also removed as it is not the plan we have for Muspell.

[h2]New mob and cave spawn algorithm[/h2]

Mobs generation and caves have been completely redesigned to better suit the procedural and infinite aspect of the game. Initially we added lots of campfires around the world to spawn goblins, but this is not the case anymore. There is a density factor and mob capacity limit to make the game smoother.


[h2]Reworked Gamepad UX[/h2]

We initially planned to move a cursor using dpad when in the inventory screen, but it quickly appeared to be cumbersome, and it has been on the roadmap since probably day 1 or 2. Now it’s partially done and when you play Muspell with gamepad, the inventory screen now uses a pointer like if you had a mouse.


[h2]World streaming[/h2]

This had to be done since a very long time too. Now the chunks will unload and reload properly as you move. This includes lots of fixes for multiplayer too.

One major change with this new system is that entities (monsters) are now saved and restored with chunks.


[h2]Combat[/h2]

We tried to make the combats more dynamic by increasing the attack speed of player and removing the attack prepare phase of mobs. There is a slightly increased push force applied to mobs when they’re hit.

Hope you’ll enjoy this release. See you for the Alpha 12!

One major change with this new system is that entities (monsters) are now saved and restored with chunks.

notes.title: Muspell Alpha 0.10 - Powerups and Tooltips
notes.content:
Hey, here is a fresh new update for Muspell Alpha, with some cool additions!

[h2]Tooltips[/h2]

Before 0.10 there was no way to know what the items are used for, so one on my priorities was to add some description when you’re hovering an item with mouse.

Unfortunately it won’t work with the gamepads (yet) as I’m still trying to figure out the best way to handle such tooltips without mouse. There is also a major rewrite of the Gamepad UX going on, as I’m not satisfied with current implementation.

[h2]Power Ups and Armor[/h2]

This is where the fun begin! Most of the equipment in the game now grant the player some cool bonus to the stats.

As an example, the boots will give you 10% move speed increase.

Most of the equipment items will also increase your physical armor that is used to reduce the damage monsters deal to you. This is a very simple math at the moment, an armor stat of 3 will reduce damage received by 3.

You can combine multiple pieces of equipment to increase your overall armor and then reduce damage down to zero!

[h2]What’s next[/h2]

The backlog for Muspell is huge, there are many things to come, but here are some points I’m considering working on for the next updates :

[list]
[*] We should be able to remove props (torch, chest, …)
[*] Add buffs and potions
[*] Fireballs and other projectiles
[*] Make the combats more interesting
[*] Procedural quests (yeah!)
[*] Portals
[/list]

notes.title: Muspell 0.9 - Gameplay tweaks and Stamina
notes.content:
Hey guys, after some time off, it's now time for a new update! 

In this patch i've completely removed the stamina from the gameplay. Why? Because it was simply not fun. The more I played the game, the more I was frustrated about having to rest to continue building/fighting. This was even more frustrating in multiplayer where not everybody plays at the same pace.

The stamina gauge is now showing the XP progression for leveling, which was asked by some of you. You can still rest at a campfire, but it will simply slowly restore your HP.

Hope you'll find these changes useful to the gameplay, here's the full changelog :

- removed stamina
- display xp progression gauge
- crops grow up quicker
- you can rest to restore some HP
- fixed: sometimes the merchants could attack the hero
- fixed: FPS/TPS toggle in local coop

There are also some bug fixes and improvements, such as Invert Y Axis in options, or Mute Audio/Music.

notes.title: Muspell 0.2 - Hoobs
notes.content:
Muspell 0.2 is now available, while this is mostly a bug fix version, I found time to introduce a new Language options and also a new character for merchant. 

Merchants are now using a wolf-like model which has no real name yet. It was codenamed « hoob » in the project since a very long time.

Here is the full changelog of this release :
- A new model for the merchant
- Added a Language option in main menu
- You can now attribute stat points using gamepad
- Fixed stat points on client side
- Fixed block creation on client side
- Fixed jump height of monsters
- You can’t place blocks on players, monsters or props
- Fixed water surface texture
- Fixed world seed restore 

There are many features on my roadmap, so stay tuned for the build 0.3 next week.
